label: champion at full power for the UI: 8 threads, 3 s/move, games opening book
elo_note: Calibrated with 8 threads and 1000 ms time budget. Depth reach at 1s doubled from depth 6-8 to depth 12-13 through direct 1D array ray stepping, zero-alloc SEE, single-probe TT, DeepLMP, quiescence TT probing/storing, and deferred move generation. The network was retrained on 2026-09-18 on a deduplicated corpus: the five pools merged to 10,957,828 distinct positions, 4,797,515 exact duplicates dropped out of 15,755,343 read. It read +15 +/- 11 over 3,600 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.78. The same five pools with their duplicates kept read -19 +/- 20 and self-play positions alone -26 +/- 20, so the gain is the deduplication, not the extra rows. Razoring was adopted 2026-09-18: depths 1 to 3 whose static evaluation stands more than 2.0 + 1.5*depth pawns below the window are verified with a quiescence search instead of searched at full width, which is 94.7% of the plain node count over six positions at depth 7 and +14 +/- 12 over 3,000 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.26. This file had been left without the improving flag when it was adopted (+12 +/- 11 over 4,000 games), so the UI champion was playing behind the real one; aligned 2026-09-18. Retrained 2026-09-19 on 11,527,328 distinct positions, the deduplicated corpus plus 569,483 new ones from self-play at play depth 3 and label depth 6. It reads +9 +/- 10 over 5,100 games at 100 ms. SPRT[0,10] never settled, llr +2.04, because an effect sitting on the threshold cannot be told from it; SPRT[-5,5] settled better at llr +4.89, which rules out a regression, and that is the bar a corpus 5% larger was adopted on. Retrained again 2026-09-19 on 12,982,332 distinct positions: the previous corpus plus 1,455,021 new ones from self-play labelled at depth 4 rather than 6. It reads +12 +/- 11 over 3,900 games at 100 ms, SPRT[0,10] settled better at llr +3.01. Labelling at depth 4 generates 1,261 positions a second against 132 at depth 6, so the cheaper labels bought more Elo per hour of machine time than the dearer ones did.
